summary_1line: Ravana angrily rebukes his spies for praising Rama, sends new agents to scout; they are captured by Vibhishana but released by Rama and return reporting the army.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana, eyes blazing on his throne in Lanka, angrily rebukes the bowed spies Shuka and Sarana before his demon court.
Disguised demon spies creep toward Rama’s vast monkey army near Mount Suvela as Vibhishana suddenly points them out.
Rama compassionately orders the release of the battered spy Shardula while monkeys crowd around the captive demons.
